text: {"lessons":["Selling only because a position is showing a gain can make me realize small wins while leaving me exposed to losses; I should judge each holding by its future prospects, not its purchase price.","A short-term gain or loss does not tell me whether a trade was sound, so I should consider the whole portfolio and my risk allocation rather than treating each stock as a separate account.","Frequent checking and trading can encourage impulsive decisions; I should use clear goals and a consistent plan when deciding whether to buy, sell, or hold."]}
